title: Eject! Eject!
caption: Eject! Eject! (V)
game_text: Deploy on opponent’s starfighter with a permanent pilot. Starfighter’s game text (except related to identity and ability of permanent pilot, and capacity) is suspended and it is forfeit +5. {icon:immune-alter}
lore: The Guidenhouser ejection seat has saved many pilots from their exploding starships. However, system malfunctions have sometimes caused spontaneous ejection.

notes: Non-unique (no dot). Wiki base page lists the 350 px ANH-L-ejecteject-decipher-archive.gif (also downloaded); used the 745 px ANH-L-ejecteject.gif which carries a 'D-E1' label. Modern remake is Block-era only (VB4 -pre), modern=null. Immunity icons on the slip are a letter in a red circle with a red slash (the sheet's ICON KEY: A = Immune to Alter, C = Immune to Control, S = Immune to Sense); tokened as {icon:immune-alter}/{icon:immune-control}/{icon:immune-sense}.
